mts_selector_only_metadata_update_trigger = {
	OR = {
		any_in_list = { list = added_doctrines count >= 1 }
		any_in_list = { list = removed_doctrines count >= 1 }
	}
	NOT = { any_in_list = { list = added_tenets count >= 1 } }
	NOT = { any_in_list = { list = removed_tenets count >= 1 } }
	NOT = {
		any_in_list = {
			list = added_doctrines
			NOT = { mts_selector_internal_doctrine_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		any_in_list = {
			list = removed_doctrines
			NOT = { mts_selector_internal_doctrine_trigger = yes }
		}
	}
}
